Cash Bids Grain – Wisconsin Grain
Grain Cash Bids
Many factors affect the markets, and almost all of these factors are unpredictable. Compare local grain bid prices in your area with cash bids. There are always opportunities to capture the market, capitalize on windows of opportunity to sell at a good price, and take action on your marketing plan with the help of your Grain Marketing Specialist. Below are Wisconsin corn prices, soybean prices, wheat prices, and soybean meal prices.
Cash Bids are based on at least 10-minute delayed futures prices and are subject to change.
ALCIVIA will only contract grain during open market hours (Mon-Fri 8:30 am-1:15 pm, excluding market holidays).
